description: Source code for Android's Gralloc2 graphics buffer management, including classes for mapping, allocating, and handling graphics buffers with detailed functions for buffer validation, creation, import, locking, unlocking, and debug info.

classes.name: Gralloc2Mapper
classes.description: Handles buffer mapping, validation, creation, import, and locking for graphics buffers.

classes.name: Gralloc2Allocator
classes.description: Manages buffer allocation and debug info for graphics buffers.

methods.name: preload
methods.description: Preloads the IMapper service in passthrough mode.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the mapper or allocator service is loaded.

methods.name: validateBufferDescriptorInfo
methods.description: Validates buffer descriptor info for correctness.

methods.name: createDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a buffer descriptor based on provided info.

methods.name: importBuffer
methods.description: Imports a buffer handle from a raw handle.

methods.name: validateBufferSize
methods.description: Validates the size of a buffer.

methods.name: getTransportSize
methods.description: Retrieves transport size info for a buffer handle.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks a buffer for access, returning a data pointer.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks a buffer for YCbCr access, returning layout info.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a buffer and returns a release fence.

methods.name: dumpDebugInfo
methods.description: Returns debug info for the allocator.
